country.name: Eritrea
country.jurisdictionNotice: The Ministry of Education and six zoba education offices govern basic education records; technical and vocational education and higher education require their own competent authority and institution evidence.
country.languagePolicy: Mother-tongue instruction and national-language teacher capacity are central to early education, while English has a distinct later instructional role. Tigrinya, Tigre, Arabic, Afar, Saho, Bilen, Kunama, Nara, Rashaida language contexts and Eritrean Sign Language require exact locality, orthography, curriculum approval and community review.

review.policy: No category becomes verified without a named qualified Eritrean reviewer and current evidence from the Ministry, zoba office, National Commission for Higher Education or institution.

governanceModel.summary: The Ministry of Education and six zoba education offices administer basic education; technical-vocational programs and higher-education colleges operate through separate structures and quality oversight.
governanceModel.schoolRule: Preserve official name and identifier, zoba, sub-zoba, locality, level, ownership, language of instruction, authorization, current operation and census date. Annual census presence is not current authorization.
governanceModel.higherEducationRule: Institution recognition, campus, exact program, award authority, quality review, accreditation and current operation are separate claims.

authorities.name: Ministry of Education
authorities.role: national basic, adult, technical and vocational education policy and administration within its mandate

authorities.name: Six zoba education offices
authorities.role: annual school census, territorial administration and school-record validation

authorities.name: Department of Research and Human Resource Development
Competent curriculum and textbook services
authorities.role: national curriculum, subject programs, textbooks and language implementation

authorities.name: Competent technical and vocational education authority
authorities.role: TVET provider, trade, assessment and qualification oversight

authorities.name: National Commission for Higher Education
authorities.role: higher-education oversight, standards, evaluation and accreditation

authorities.name: Ministry responsible for Labour and Social Welfare
authorities.role: child and social protection policy, services and referral

curriculum.authority: Ministry of Education competent curriculum services
curriculum.title: National curriculum by level, grade, subject and language
curriculum.implementationRule: A national overview, policy, textbook, news report or curriculum-review announcement is not the controlling grade-and-subject curriculum. Verify level, grade, subject or vocational trade, language, approving instrument, version and effective school year.
curriculum.supplementPolicy: Policy, framework, subject syllabus, mother-tongue material, textbook, assessment specification and external resource are separate layers.

schoolDirectory.authority: Ministry of Education and responsible zoba education office
schoolDirectory.scopeNotice: The official 2023/24 Basic Education Statistics publication is based on school censuses collected through zoba offices and expressly says its data are not exhaustive. Census inclusion and statistical counts are not proof of current authorization or operation. Verify every institution through the responsible zoba record.
requiredRecordFields: level, services and language of instruction
public, community, private or other ownership
census year, source and review date

educationStatistics.authority: Ministry Department of Research and Human Resource Development and zoba offices
educationStatistics.scopeNotice: The 2023/24 report is the 26th annual Ministry basic-education publication and covers early childhood and general education. Preserve census school year, zoba, level, ownership, language, sex, definition and denominator. It states that coverage is not exhaustive and is not a live authorization directory.

vocationalQualifications.authority: Competent Ministry technical and vocational education service
vocationalQualifications.authorityNotice: Regular training delivery or a digital resource library does not establish current provider authorization or qualification recognition. Verify provider, location, trade, curriculum, assessment, award authority, level and validity separately.

higherEducation.authority: National Commission for Higher Education and its standards and evaluation function
higherEducation.authorityNotice: A government article or historical college list is not a current public register of recognized institutions and programs. Verify institution, campus, exact program, degree authority, standards decision, accreditation status, current operation and validity separately.

privacyAndSafeguarding.dataProtectionLaw: No verified comprehensive personal-data protection law was located; Article 18 of the 1997 Constitution states a right to privacy
privacyAndSafeguarding.dataProtectionAuthority: No verified operational comprehensive personal-data protection authority was located
privacyAndSafeguarding.childrenFramework: 2015 Civil Code provisions on minors, applicable Penal and Labour Codes, CRC and ACRWC commitments, and current social-protection policy and procedures
privacyAndSafeguarding.scopeNotice: A constitutional privacy right is not a comprehensive processing framework. A current legal review must address lawful basis, sensitive and biometric data, learner rights, transfers, retention, security and incidents. Civil Code protections do not replace current education-sector reporting, referral, consent, inclusion and emergency procedures, which must be approved before a real learner pilot.

culturalAndLanguageRequirements.rule: Tigrinya, Tigre, Arabic, Afar, Saho, Bilen, Kunama, Nara, Rashaida language contexts, English and Eritrean Sign Language have distinct instructional and community roles. Preserve script, variety, zoba, curriculum approval and community review. Automatic translation is not localization.

completionCriteria: A qualified Eritrean education reviewer is named.
Ministry, zoba, TVET, higher-education and child-protection responsibilities are verified.
A verified current public school authorization directory is documented or the gap remains visible.
Every statistic preserves census year, zoba, level, ownership, language, sex, definition and denominator.
Every curriculum record preserves level, grade, subject or trade, language, instrument, version and effective year.
Every higher-education claim separately verifies institution, campus, exact program, award, quality decision, accreditation, operation and validity.
A current personal-data legal review and education-sector child-safeguarding review are approved before a real learner pilot.
National-language, English and sign-language contexts remain distinct.
